say:5:1034422004:1.text: Lyca remains unaware of the profound likeness she shares with Eironn. Bound by an unwavering sense of duty, both carry burdens they do not wish to share.
say:5:1034422004:1.source_cn: 连莱卡自己都不知道，她在某些方面和埃隆很像。俩人都因为...

say:6:1034422005:1.text: Compared to them, I feel as small as an ant.
say:6:1034422005:1.source_cn: 与他们相比，我时常觉得自己很渺小。

say:8:1034422006:1.text: I'm grateful for your words, but please don't get me wrong. I've never been bothered by that thought.
say:8:1034422006:1.source_cn: 很高兴被你肯定，但是请别误会，我从未被这种想法困扰。
say:8:1034422006:1.male: I'm grateful for your words, but please don't get me wrong. I've never been bothered by that thought.

say:9:1034422007:1.text: Every gust of wind has its own destined path, as do I.
say:9:1034422007:1.source_cn: 我深知每一缕风都有它要去的地方，我也有自己的路。
say:9:1034422007:1.male: Every gust of wind has its own destined path, as do I.
say:9:1034422007:1.female: Every gust of wind has its own destined path, as do I.

say:10:1034422008:1.source_cn: 可是，莱卡恐怕不会这样想。

say:11:1034422009:1.text: I wish she would realize that she doesn't have to follow in his footsteps.
say:11:1034422009:1.source_cn: 真希望她能意识到，她根本不必追逐埃隆的步伐。
say:11:1034422009:1.male: I wish she would realize that she doesn't have to follow in his footsteps.

say:15:1034422011:1.text: Of anyone I've known, Lyca is the most disciplined. And the one who drives her to be her best is none other than Eironn.
say:15:1034422011:1.source_cn: 在我认识的人当中，莱卡最为自律。而驱动她拼尽全力的人，...

say:16:1034422012:1.text: Perhaps she hasn't even realized she's bound her aspirations to the lofty standards set by Eironn.
say:16:1034422012:1.source_cn: 可能连她自己都未曾意识到，她一直试图把自己与天才相比。

say:16:1034422012:1.female: Perhaps she hasn't even realized she's bound her aspirations to the lofty standards set by Eironn.

say:17:1034422013:1.text: Hopefully, Lyca will understand that some winds do not have to chase each other. As the winds dance, our own paths may intertwine but still remain unique.
say:17:1034422013:1.source_cn: 希望莱卡也能意识到，风儿不必彼此追逐，大家都有各自的轨迹。
say:17:1034422013:1.male: Hopefully, Lyca will understand that some winds do not have to chase each other. As the winds dance, our own paths may intertwine but still remain unique.

say:18:1034422014:1.text: I think she's already good enough, yet she perceives a vast distance between her current self and the lofty ideals she envisions.

say:18:1034422014:1.female: I think she's already good enough, yet she perceives a vast distance between her current self and the lofty ideals she envisions.

say:19:1034422015:1.text: But could her ideal self be a version of Eironn? She's been following in his footsteps for a long time.

say:20:1034422016:1.text: The Dark Forest doesn't need a second Eironn. May Lyca, like a distinct, unwavering star, illuminate the darkness with her true self.
say:20:1034422016:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林不需要第二个埃隆，我希望莱卡永远是莱卡。

say:22:1034422018:1.text: Lorsan once told me that his sister was insecure about her duties. I always regarded this with skepticism.
